prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Sugar Land, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1460; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, so you can just use the claim number.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was driving through the intersection in Sugar Land, Texas, heading east on the main road. The light had been green for me when I entered.

Q: What happened next?

A: A vehicle coming from the cross street on my right pulled out and hit the driver's side of my car. It was a side impact, and my car spun a little before stopping.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before it hit you?

A: Not really. I saw something move at the edge of my vision, but I didn't have time to react. I braked as hard as I could.

Q: Were you injured?

A: Yes. My left wrist hit the door frame and the window area. I was taken by ambulance to the hospital, where they found a fracture in my wrist. I've been wearing a splint and I can't grip things well right now.

Q: Did you have any passengers?

A: No, I was alone in the car.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I was following the traffic rules and I'm willing to provide my medical records and the repair estimate for the car.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.

A: Thanks.
